instruction: What are the parameters of this IC device operating in bidirectional mode?
output: Interlinking Converter (IC) connected to bus 14 operates in bidirectional mode, with base frequency of 60.0Hz. Bus support capacitance is 0.0080 pu,  grid-side resistance is 0.0050 pu, grid-side inductance is 7.5000 pu.

instruction: Explain the control parameters of the IC converter at bus 17.
output: Interlinking Converter (IC) connected to bus 17 operates in inverter mode, with base frequency of 60.0Hz. Bus support capacitance is 0.0080 pu,  grid-side resistance is 0.0050 pu, grid-side inductance is 7.5000 pu.
